P01.title: Forensic Repository & Reality Reconstruction
P01.objective: Reconstruct the current VYRON implementation from code, routes, services, data, tests and runtime evidence before changing anything.
P01.directive: Reconstruct → design → implement → test → observe → verify → document → reverify. Never begin by blindly editing code.

A.title: Authority & scope
A.fullBody:
Authority & scope
In **P01 — Forensic Repository & Reality Reconstruction**, control **Authority & scope** explicitly. Establish the authoritative source, the exact state or interaction being changed, the inputs and outputs, and the boundary that prevents accidental coupling. Use the existing VYRON architecture wherever it already satisfies the contract; extend rather than duplicate. Measure the current state before changing it. Capture implementation evidence and test artifacts. Treat uncertainty as first-class state. Distinguish simulated, fallback, inferred, stale, blocked and live conditions. 
**Required evidence:** concrete code/config/runtime/test artifact plus provenance.  
**Failure condition:** any silent assumption, duplicate authority, missing authorization, stale claim presented as current, or unverified external mutation.  
**Convergence gate:** this letter is PASS only when the behavior is observable, reproducible and attributable to the correct source of truth.
A.failureCondition: any silent assumption, duplicate authority, missing authorization, stale claim presented as current, or unverified external mutation.
A.convergenceGate: this letter is PASS only when the behavior is observable, reproducible and attributable to the correct source of truth.

## GLOBAL IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS
### GitHub truth pipeline
Implement the canonical flow: CONNECT ACCOUNT → AUTHENTICATE ON GITHUB → VERIFY INSTALLATION/SCOPES → DISCOVER ACCESSIBLE REPOS → ENROLL WITH CONSENT → INGEST EVENTS → NORMALIZE → DEDUPLICATE → ORDER → PERSIST → RECONCILE → ANALYZE → RESOLVE CURRENT PROJECT STATE → EXPOSE EVIDENCE → INVALIDATE STALE CLAIMS → REVERIFY.

### Running-state truth model
Support at least: UNKNOWN, DISCOVERED, READY, BUILDING, RUNNING, DEPLOYING, LIVE, DEGRADED, FAILED, STOPPED, STALE, BLOCKED, FALLBACK, VERIFIED. State selection must record source provider, source resource, observed-at timestamp, freshness, confidence/epistemic class, and evidence IDs. Never show RUNNING or LIVE merely because a project record exists.

### Copilot operating model
The copilot may plan, inspect, query, propose, simulate and act only within declared capability boundaries. It must surface tools/connectors used, target resources, authorization, expected change, risk, postcondition, and evidence. Never expose private chain-of-thought. Use concise reasoning summaries instead.

### Connector / plugin model
Every connector must declare provider, capability set, auth mode, scopes, resources, environment, read/write/destructive actions, latency SLO, freshness SLA, rate/quota posture, cost model, health, replay strategy, evidence adapter, revocation path and certification status.

### Interactive engine preview
The preview must allow users to switch among at least: EXPERIENCE, ARCHITECTURE, CHANGE IMPACT, RUNTIME, INTEGRATIONS, AI ACTIONS, RELEASE, SIMULATION, EVIDENCE. Each view must use canonical state and link to the underlying evidence rather than creating its own truth.

### Requested public/product explanation surfaces
Implement the requested Brahma/VYRON sections as truthful product surfaces. Each section must pull live capability metadata where possible, show current state/evidence where relevant, and clearly label roadmap, simulation, fallback or unavailable capabilities. Never let marketing copy become an authoritative engineering claim.

1. VYRON_EXPERIENCE_EXPANSION_DEFECT_AND_GAP_REGISTER.csv
2. VYRON_EXPERIENCE_EXPANSION_ARCHITECTURE.md

4. VYRON_EXPERIENCE_EXPANSION_CONNECTOR_AND_PLUGIN_CATALOG.csv
5. VYRON_EXPERIENCE_EXPANSION_COPILOT_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.csv
6. VYRON_EXPERIENCE_EXPANSION_TEST_MATRIX.csv

8. VYRON_EXPERIENCE_EXPANSION_RELEASE_READINESS.md
9. VYRON_EXPERIENCE_EXPANSION_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md

## STOP-THE-LINE CONDITIONS
Stop and mark BLOCKED/FAIL if: GitHub authorization is faked; a user is silently signed out; tenant isolation is broken; an external mutation occurs without authorization; Work Pulse reappears in the sidebar; a project is shown RUNNING/LIVE without current evidence; simulation is presented as reality; a stale deployment state is treated as current; an agent tool call cannot be attributed; evidence can be forged or overwritten; provider identity collisions merge unrelated projects; or a fix weakens security/governance to make a test pass.

## FINAL COMMAND
DO NOT BEGIN BY BUILDING UI.
DO NOT BEGIN BY COPYING COMPETITORS.
DO NOT BEGIN BY ADDING RANDOM FEATURES.

BEGIN BY RECONSTRUCTING REALITY.
THEN IDENTIFY THE CAPABILITY GAP.
THEN DEFINE THE CANONICAL SOURCE OF TRUTH.
THEN DESIGN THE CONTROL CONTRACT.
THEN IMPLEMENT THE EXPERIENCE.
THEN PROVE EVERY IMPORTANT STATE.
THEN ATTACK THE SYSTEM.
THEN INVALIDATE STALE CLAIMS.
THEN REVERIFY.
THEN CERTIFY ONLY WHAT IS ACTUALLY PROVEN.

FINAL SUCCESS CONDITION:
VYRON is not merely a better vibe-coding interface. VYRON becomes the system that can continuously tell a human, with evidence, what the project is, where it runs, what changed, which AI or human changed it, what is affected, whether the running state is real, what is safe to do next, what is authorized, what actually happened, what evidence was produced, what became stale, and whether the final engineering state can be reproduced.
